messages:
mike: Heads-up — planning to flip `adaptive_batching` -> ON tonight at 02:00 UTC (maintenance window). Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> full. Need an owner for smoke and someone to watch rollback readiness.

anika: I can own smoke 02:00-02:40 UTC. Will run the quick checklist and post results here. Happy to have a shadow.

mike: Awesome, thanks. Rollback playbook is at https://go.internal/runbooks/flags/adaptive_batching-rollback. Quick rollback command below so it's handy in the thread: 
```bash
# rollback to safe default (off)
curl -X POST "https://config.redwood/api/v1/flags/adaptive_batching" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"value": false}'
```

leon: I'll watch dashboards/traces during the canary. Key metrics to monitor: p50/p95 gen latency, error-rate by tenant, GPU util, KV cache hit-rate. If p95 > 1s or errors > 0.5% sustained for 5m, escalate.

tara: Confirmed safe defaults are applied for the canary: `fallback_model=small-llm@v1.2`, aggressive batching disabled. I ran the same smoke in staging earlier today; passed.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle job created by mike for 2056007890 (02:00 UTC). Job id: jb-2056007890. Will post start/complete events and job logs here.

anika: Short smoke checklist I'll run and update with ✅/❌:
- basic chat flow
- embedding sanity (sample tenant)
- multi-tenant isolation test
- latency p50/p95 check
- error-rate sanity

mike: Perfect. If anything is NOTOK, immediate rollback + ping #oncall and @leon. Leaving the window at 02:00-03:00 UTC; we'll keep the thread for live updates. :thumbsup:
